package com.x;
import javax.baja.sys.*;
/**
 * BDash: a facade whose display slots are link-in targets, linked from the control module.
 * The integrator links control points into its display slots. See {@link BDashService}.
 */
@NiagaraType
@NiagaraProperty(
  name = "defrostStart",
  type = "BAbsTime",
  defaultValue = "BAbsTime.NULL",
  flags = Flags.TRANSIENT | Flags.SUMMARY | Flags.READONLY
)
@NiagaraProperty(
  name = "status",
  type = "double",
  defaultValue = "0d",
  flags = Flags.SUMMARY | Flags.READONLY
)
public class BDash extends BComponent {
}
